payload.title: Getting data into LiPD
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to use the PyLiPD library to convert CSV-based chronology data into the LiPD data format. It begins with pre-fabricated LiPD files and involves generating unique identifiers, loading empty LiPD files, and exporting them to a Datasets object. The notebook utilizes various classes from the PyLiPD library to handle different data types and structures.
goals: Illustrate the use of PyLiPD for data conversion
Load CSV-based chronology data into LiPD format

section_blurbs.blurb: The section introduces the process of using PyLiPD to load CSV-based chronology data into the LiPD format. It includes generating unique identifiers, loading empty LiPD files, and exporting them to a Datasets object.
